title: Flank Steak & Green Beans
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json (or the flagged label/USDA unit weights where densities has no row) so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%. Marinade is counted in full, matching the source's own published nutrition (their 15 g sugars/serving is the whole honey).
ruled_substitutions: Coconut aminos -> soy sauce, SOURCE-SANCTIONED: the line itself prints '1/4 CUP COCONUT AMINOS (OR SOY SAUCE)'. Coconut aminos has no board commodity; soy-sauce is 7 of 7. Macro delta is small and in the honest direction (soy is slightly higher protein, near-equal carbs vs aminos' sugars).

ingredients.notes: Existing ingredient-map authority: item 'Beef Flank/Sirloin Steak' -> sirloin-steak (weekly), i.e. the house has already ruled flank and sirloin one price class ($5.49-10.99/lb board range brackets real flank pricing) - this mapping follows that entry rather than minting anything. The bare TERM 'flank steak' is unclaimed by any commodity (CAPTURE tier: one Walmart fajita-seasoned tray) - term gap noted below. sirloin-steak 7 of 7 stores, cheapest Family Fare $5.49/lb. Main protein anchored by source WEIGHT, exact 3.5x. DB row Beef Flank/Sirloin Steak (USDA lean raw, 155 cal/100 g).
densities cup=216 g; 0.875 cup = 189 g, exact 3.5x. Counted in full per the source's own nutrition basis; real absorbed fraction is lower, but discounting it would be a guess. Board 7 of 7.
densities clove=3 g; 3.5 cloves = 10.5 g rounded 11. Board 5 of 7.
label 21 g/tbsp; 10.5 tbsp = 220.5 g rounded 221, exact 3.5x. This one line is 12.8 g of the 22.6 g carbs/serving - it is the marinade sugar the source itself publishes. Board 7 of 7.
densities 15 g/tbsp. Board 5 of 7, cheapest Walmart $0.1192/floz.
SOURCE-SANCTIONED substitution, see ruled_substitutions. densities cup=255 g; 0.875 cup = 223 g. Board 7 of 7, cheapest Aldi $0.11/floz.
No quantity on the page (extractor concern); optional to-taste line, zero grams booked, NOT enqueued.

ingredients.source_raw: 16 OUNCES FRESH OR FROZEN GREEN BEANS

The fresh-green-beans commodity is also carried (6 of 7) if the writer prefers the fresh read; either satisfies the source. Exact 3.5x = 56 oz.
second listed oil line (Green Beans section), kept separate to trace to the extraction. Board 7 of 7.

macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS - protein gap +13.3% is inside the 15% tolerance but worth its sentence: the source served '4 ounces of steak' from a 1 lb raw flank (cooking loss), while our raw-basis label row books the full raw pound; that direction and size of gap is exactly what a raw-vs-cooked serving basis produces and does not indicate a wrong portion. Fat matches to within 1% (37.6 vs 38), which pins the big oil lines as correctly counted-in-full, same as their calculator.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 543.3 cal in [400, 650] PASS; carbs 22.6 g <= 35 PASS

board_defects_observed: Term 'flank steak' is claimed by no commodity (CAPTURE tier) even though the ingredient-map's own 'Beef Flank/Sirloin Steak' item routes to sirloin-steak - a term-resolution gap: any future recipe writing the bare term will look unpriced while the item is priced 7 of 7. A flank include-pattern on sirloin-steak would close it, but that is a commodities.json matching change and goes through the match-soundness gate, not this run.
